faq.1.a: No. The agent screens and asks; who gets hired is still your call. It hands you every interview summarized and scored so you can decide in minutes.
faq.1.q: Does it replace my hiring team?
faq.2.a: Because that is where candidates answer. No downloads, no links to a portal: they reply in text or voice notes whenever it suits them.
faq.3.a: You set the questions for each role and the must-have requirements. The agent tailors its follow-up questions to what each CV says.
faq.4.a: CVs and conversations belong to you alone. Candidates know from the first message that they are talking to an assistant, and can ask for a person.
faq.title: Questions
features.1.body: Drop in a pile of PDF or Word CVs. The agent pulls out experience, education and contact details, and sets aside anyone missing the minimum requirements.
features.1.title: Upload CVs, no templates
features.2.body: It messages each candidate on WhatsApp and runs a first interview at their pace, with questions drawn from their own CV.
features.2.title: Interviews over WhatsApp
features.3.body: Every candidate arrives with a summary, their answers and a score against the role. You only talk to the ones worth your time.
features.3.title: A shortlist, not a pile
features.title: Hiring that works while you don't
